GNB.note: Nothing on civil register and ID links.
No enrolment count or share is given.
The unique number is said to follow people for life but nothing says it is given at birth registration.

facts.fact: Semlex, a vendor, runs the biometric enrolment centres and supplies secure ECOWAS identity cards in Guinea-Bissau under a public-private partnership with the Ministry of Justice dating from 2006, while the Ministry of Justice manages the unique identity number, says Semlex.

GNB.note: No public register keyed on the number is described.

facts.fact: Guinea-Bissau issues national identity cards (CNI) after biometric enrolment, each citizen being assigned a unique identity number managed by the Ministry of Justice, with new Semlex enrolment centres opened at Farim and Bissora in September 2024, says Semlex.

GNB.note: The 2006 public-private partnership is named without any amount.
